title: Renderflow page content v1
description: Reviewed locale content is separate from immutable page artwork/layout. Structurally accepted RTL/vertical declarations currently produce unsupported writing-capability diagnostics. The source/default locale passes through the same planner as every locale.

reviewed.description: Consumer declaration; unreviewed text produces a diagnostic and cannot qualify a visual branch.

content.description: Stable semantic content IDs. Runtime additionally caps UTF-8 bytes per value, restricts XML/control characters, and requires exact correspondence with the composition's text layers. Newline is the supported explicit line break.
